141-3085-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-6797.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

6495-7940--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6495-7940--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-1308-2557-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

862-1778-1927-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1778-1927-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

5200-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat.
5200-7704.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2792-3647-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-7487.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Great Whale
When Zealous Lorecaster and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-7487.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

225-539-1362-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2100-2633-4258.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

488-641-1482-1492-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Jeweled Lotus or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1482-1492-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

803-1789-2511-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-2511-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2316-4772-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4772-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1636-1722-4067-5804.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures, one of which can tap to produce at least {1}.
1636-1722-4067-5804.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Heirloom Epic by tapping it and four creatures you control, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token  and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heirloom Epic.
Repeat.

394-1570-3674.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
394-1570-3674.description:
Cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to mill two cards, return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand, and discard Necroplasm.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

640-4050-4875-5170.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
640-4050-4875-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding one mana of any color.
Junji dies, triggering itself and Dross Harvester.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2178-2604-3441.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Unlicensed Hearse to become a creature this turn.
Unlicensed Hearse does not have summoning sickness.
1806-2034-2178-2604-3441.description:
Cause Unlicensed Hearse to become a creature.
Activate Thornbite Staff's equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to Unlicensed Hearse.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge dies, triggering Unlicensed Hearse, untapping Unlicensed Hearse.
Activate Unlicensed Hearse by tapping it, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
